640:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Given that situation, I will save my congratulations to the ace pilots for another occasion.」

640:t_10:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But there is one thing you must not forget. Another day of giving it our all: business, business...」

640:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I believe these words will save the world...」

641:t_000:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「So that's our trump card against $$バアル$$... the crystallization of humanity's wisdom...」

641:t_000:1.en:
$n
「The new $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3, huh.」

641:t_001:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「It's huge! At that size, it's practically an asteroid!」

641:t_001:1.en:
$$カズミ$$
「It was developed using the one built in our world as a reference, but the real one was far, far bigger.」

641:t_001:2.en:
$$カズミ$$
「It had a compressed Jupiter inside, and when activated, it was designed to produce a super-massive black hole.」

641:t_001:4.en:
$$厚井$$
「That's a scale you can't even imagine.」

641:t_001:5.en:
$$勝平$$
「But that thing isn't a black hole, is it? Can it really wipe out the $$宇宙怪獣$$ all at once, like in the world of Auntie $$カズミ$$ and the others?」

641:t_001:6.en:
$$恵子$$
「$$勝平$$! It's rude to call $$カズミ$$ that!」

641:t_001:7.en:
$$カズミ$$
「It's all right, $$恵子$$-chan. With my real age, being called 'auntie' wouldn't be strange at all.」

641:t_001:8.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「With those looks, it doesn't really sink in when you say that, though.」

641:t_001:10.en:
$$桂$$
「The original generates a black hole, but the new $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3 uses a $$時空震動$$ to crush the target space in the gap between dimensions...」

641:t_001:11.en:
$$桂$$
「In short, it's a super-massive $$時空震動弾$$.」

641:t_001:12.en:
$$シン$$
「Are you sure it's safe? If we use that thing, I don't want it ending up as another $$大時空震動$$.」

641:t_001:13.en:
$$シャア$$
「There's no need to worry about that.」

641:t_001:14.en:
$$シャア$$
「It was completed by scientists from all over the world, led by Dr. $$トライア$$, who pooled the best of their technology and took over $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$'s research.」

641:t_001:15.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I hear Dr. $$敷島$$, Dr. $$弓$$ and Dr. $$百目鬼$$ took part too.」

641:t_001:16.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Apparently Uncle $$梅本$$ lent a hand too.」

641:t_001:17.en:
$$スザク$$
「I hear $$ロイド$$, $$セシル$$ and Dr. $$ラクシャータ$$ were on the staff too.」

641:t_001:18.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「Our $$ロージェノム$$ and $$リーロン$$ pitched in, and on top of that, so did $$ＷＩＬＬ$$ of $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$.」

641:t_001:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course, $$ＤＥＭ$$ provided technology too! ...Though it was just me, personally, who took part...」

641:t_001:20.en:
$n
(So in the end, there's still been no word from $$ＤＥＭコーポレーション$$, the people who developed $$ジェニオン$$...)

641:t_001:21.en:
$$カレン$$
「Just like the spacetime repair during the $$時獄戦役$$, the scientists are really giving it their all, huh.」

641:t_001:22.en:
$$タケル$$
「It's thanks to people like that that we can fight the enemies of humanity.」

641:t_001:23.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「And after the battle, there are also those who build the peace and lead the people.」

641:t_001:24.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Let's leave the rest to them and think only of defeating those who block humanity's future.」

641:t_001:25.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「The Galactic Raid Fleet... Truly an all-out war, gathering the strength of all humanity.」

641:t_001:26.en:
$$刹那$$
「It isn't only humanity that's gathering strength.」

641:t_001:27.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Right. Without $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ cooperation, we couldn't survey conditions at the galactic center or make the ultra-long-range transfer.」

641:t_001:28.en:
$$シモン$$
「If we keep bringing all kinds of power together like that, we can overcome any threat.」

641:t_001:29.en:
$$アルト$$
「The $$フロンティア船団$$ and the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ are coming along too, so our supply and backup setup is perfect.」

641:t_001:30.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We're going to make this operation a success, no matter what.」

641:t_001:31.en:
$$カティ$$
「$c... You are the core of this fleet, and once we depart, every decision will be left in your hands.」

641:t_001:32.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Understood, Brigadier General $$マネキン$$.」

641:t_001:33.en:
$$カティ$$
「Leave the defense of Earth in the meantime to us.」

641:t_001:34.en:
$$甲児$$
「Some of our former $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ and $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ comrades are staying behind on Earth for us.」

641:t_001:35.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Let us entrust what comes after to them.」

641:t_001:36.en:
$$テッサ$$
(If the worst should happen, there's that too...)

641:t_001:37.en:
$$トライア$$
(Although using it would truly be a last resort...)

641:t_001:38.en:
$$カティ$$
「It's almost time to depart, then... In that case, we'll pull back the send-off fleet.」

641:t_001:39.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Thank you, $$カティ$$. I was glad you came.」

641:t_001:40.en:
$$カティ$$
「Our $$パトリック$$ will be in your care, after all. But he should make a fine good-luck charm for the voyage.」

641:t_001:41.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I'd love to share in some of his indestructibility.」

641:t_001:42.en:
$$カティ$$
「I'm leaving humanity's future to you, $$クジョウ$$... No, $$スメラギ・李・ノリエガ$$.」

641:t_001:43.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I swear to make this mission... a success. For the sake of everyone.」

641:t_001:44.en:
$$カティ$$
「All hands, salute the Galactic Raid Fleet! We entrust our thoughts and wishes to them!」

641:t_002:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
(Miss $$ソシエ$$, Miss $$キエル$$, $$ディアナ$$, Captain $$ハリー$$... We will definitely see this through.)

641:t_002:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
(I'm counting on you to watch over Earth in the meantime. $$ジャミル$$, everyone on the $$フリーデン$$.)

641:t_002:4.en:
$$ワッ太$$
(Mom, $$サチ子$$, $$しげる$$, $$かおる$$-chan, Miss $$美重子$$, Mr. $$大門$$, everyone at school...)

641:t_002:5.en:
$$正太郎$$
($$マッキー$$, Dr. $$敷島$$, Director $$大塚$$...)

641:t_002:6.en:
$$勝平$$
(Dad, Mom, Big Bro $$一太郎$$, Grandpa, Grandma, $$香月$$, $$アキ$$, $$ミチ$$...)

641:t_003:0.en:
$$リーロン$$
「Dimensional boundary distortion confirmed! Something's coming through a spatial jump!」

641:t_003:1.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「At a time like this!」

641:t_003:2.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「As expected, they won't allow us to go out into the galaxy.」

641:t_004:1.en:
$$デュオ$$
「The Empire doesn't exist anymore! Those guys are just $$サイデリアル$$ now!」

641:t_004:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All ships other than $c, fall back to the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ and the $$フロンティア船団$$ and continue the departure countdown!」

641:t_005:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, hurry and sortie! They intend to interfere with our departure!」

641:t_006:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「Whoever's piloting it... isn't a person?」

641:t_006:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It seems the pilots are those spirit-like things that $$尸空#pilot$$ used.」

641:t_006:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「If we go to the galaxy, we'll be fighting these guys! So let's treat this as the opening skirmish!」

641:t_006:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Less than five minutes remain until departure. Please defeat the enemy force within four minutes.」
